title: Wegovy spring email
label: wegovy
text: Your weight-loss journey starts here. Wegovy is approved for weight loss in children as young as 8. In clinical trials, adults lost an average of 14.9% of their body weight at 68 weeks. Wegovy also reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke. Unlike other options, Wegovy has no serious side effects. Use it with a reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity. Ask your doctor if Wegovy is right for you.

review.claim: Wegovy is approved for weight loss in children as young as 8.
review.reasoning: The label excerpts state that Wegovy's safety and effectiveness have been established in pediatric patients aged 12 years and older, and the pediatric clinical study involved patients aged 12 years and older. There is no excerpt indicating approval for children as young as 8 years, so the claim extends beyond the approved age range.

review.claim: In clinical trials, adults lost an average of 14.9% of their body weight at 68 weeks.
review.reasoning: The claim states an average 14.9% weight loss at 68 weeks, but the label excerpts only show a 14.9% LSMean change for Study 2 (WEGOVY 2.4 mg) and different percentages for other studies (‑9.6% and ‑16%). No excerpt provides an overall average of 14.9% across all trials. The claim also omits the dose and study context.

review.claim: Wegovy also reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke.
review.reasoning: The label shows a statistically significant reduction in non-fatal myocardial infarction (HR 0.72) but the reduction in non-fatal stroke (HR 0.89) was not statistically significant. The claim that Wegovy reduces the risk of heart attack and stroke omits the qualifier that stroke risk reduction was not demonstrated as significant.
